content: Human-labeling session — def-tower-line-vs-cluster:hard seed 1. Objective: Open arena. The enemy composition flips by seed: either ONE concentrated column on y=20 or FOUR squads spread across y=4/12/28/36 (with per-row decoys at x=4 that keep each spread squad on its own latitude). Read the threat from your observation and pick the topology that matches — cluster the four pillboxes at (60,20) for the concentrated thrust, OR spread one per row at x=60 for the wide front. The wrong topology fails the kill quota. Yard intact, eight kills, within about 70 turns.
